$comment: Edit titles, intros, featured photos and visibility here, then run npm run photos:build. Per-photo overrides go in photos, keyed by photo id: title, alt, featured, hidden.

collections.title: 2025, I
collections.intro: A bus window, a yellow car, then a garden café: blue deck chairs on the lawn, a waterfall, and rooms glowing amber inside.

collections.title: 2025, II
collections.intro: A barn swallowed by ivy, baskets of tomatoes and berries, and a café dark enough that the windows do all the lighting.

collections.title: 2025, III
collections.intro: A snail crossing the sand, koi under a waterfall, and mist sitting low on the hills.

collections.title: Pattaya
collections.intro: Pattaya in April. The aquarium tunnel first, sharks and rays overhead, then the hotel, then the beach as the sun goes down over the mudflats.

collections.title: Toscana
collections.intro: An Italian-style village in Thailand: ochre facades, a leaning tower, glasshouses on still water, and almost nobody in the streets.

collections.title: The Zoo
collections.intro: A morning at the zoo, mostly through wire and bars. A white lion mid-yawn, meerkats on watch, a sheep that came to the fence.

collections.title: Khao Yai
collections.intro: Khao Yai National Park. Deer lying in the grass, deer crossing the river, a spider in the leaves, and the ridges going blue toward evening.

collections.title: Sea, 2026
collections.intro: A boat out to the islands: white wake, green hills, two boats at anchor, and water clear enough to see the fish.

collections.title: Alpaca Café
collections.intro: Sheep on the boardwalk, alpacas at the rail, grass going gold in low sun.

collections.title: Movie on the Hill
collections.intro: An open-air concert on a hillside. It starts in late sun on the grass and ends in stage light, confetti and smoke.

collections.title: U&P, People
collections.heldReason: People are the main subject. Set hidden to false once everyone shown has agreed to publication.

collections.title: U&P, Views
collections.intro: A cat in the café window, a sunflower field, and a long evening walk while the sky turned pink.

collections.title: The Ranch
collections.intro: A night at the ranch. Grill smoke, string lights, a dog crossing the yard, one street lamp.

collections.title: Hua Hin, Day 1
collections.intro: The first day in Hua Hin: grey sea from the balcony, bougainvillea, a stone elephant facing the water.

collections.title: Hua Hin, Day 2
collections.intro: The second day: a fighter jet parked on a lawn, then limestone peaks reflected in green water, with monkeys on the rails.

collections.title: Hua Hin, Views
collections.intro: Hua Hin, chosen frames: sea, sky and stone.

collections.title: Mukha Café
collections.intro: A café in the trees. Low winter sun across the terrace, a pond holding the sky, woven plates on a warm wall.

collections.title: New Year
collections.intro: New Year in a field. Pink dusk, a long exposure that turned a man into a ghost, fireworks over the crops, and a dog standing in the dark.

collections.title: Pattaya's Views
collections.intro: More from Pattaya: the aquarium tunnel, clownfish in the coral, and a small fish washed up on the sand.

collections.title: Taiwan
collections.intro: Taiwan. Painted village walls, a tea house, a mountain lake under low cloud, temple dragons, a rainy street, and a plane on the tarmac at night.

collections.title: Athit
collections.heldReason: People are the main subject. Set hidden to false once everyone shown has agreed to publication.

collections.title: Day 1
collections.intro: A long day out. The drive, then the zoo: tortoises under a heat lamp, a marmoset in a shaft of light, a lion cub in the shade, a crow and its shadow.

collections.title: Day 2
collections.intro: Lawns and back roads into dusk: a dog behind a gate, bougainvillea, power lines against a pink sky, and the Moon coming out.

collections.title: Day 3
collections.intro: A day around town. A sleeping dog, a lotus, traffic in a mirror, and a dog who looked straight at the lens.

collections.title: Day 14
collections.intro: Dogs, empty roads, birds on an old water jar, a lone tree against the hills, and one pink cloud.

collections.title: Day 15
collections.heldReason: People are the main subject. Set hidden to false once everyone shown has agreed to publication.

collections.title: Day 24
collections.intro: Roads lined with yellow trees, a red ant mound, and the sun going down behind pylons and a single tree.

collections.title: FD Home
collections.heldReason: People are the main subject. Set hidden to false once everyone shown has agreed to publication.

collections.title: Nam Khiao
collections.intro: A hillside house above farmland: garden statues, wide green views, and grass lit from behind.

collections.title: P00P3OO
collections.intro: Long lens, close up: dogs, a cherub, a car's tail light, a blue fan, a cat on a rusty stair, and a thin Moon.

collections.title: Sea Views
collections.intro: A beach resort from noon to night: the sea, the foam, a shell, a neon palm, and then the hotel lights on black water.

collections.title: Loose Frames
collections.intro: Frames that never joined a folder: two tigers and a crescent Moon.

collections.title: Beyond the Frame
collections.intro: Everything past the bottom of the exposure scale: the Moon, the Sun, Jupiter, the Pleiades, Orion and Andromeda.

strata.daylight: Full sun. The shutter is open for a few thousandths of a second.
strata.shade: Under trees, awnings and cloud. The light steps down a stop or two.
strata.dusk: The sun is low or gone. Colour cools, and the sea turns to pewter.
strata.lamplight: Now the light comes from stages, screens and aquarium glass.
strata.night: Fires, fireworks, a street lamp. Everything else is dark.
strata.deep-sky: The Moon, the Sun and the deep sky. Some of this light left its source long before there were cameras to catch it.
